$ claude-sessions machines --claude-dir <CLAUDE> --archive <ARCHIVE>
exit 0
--- stdout
MACHINE  PROJECTS  SESSIONS  LAST BACKUP       LAST SESSION
LAP-1    2         3         <LASTPUSH-HR>:00  2026-08-30 09:00

LAST BACKUP is the hour of that machine's last full push ("-" for an older version);
LAST SESSION is the newest session archived from it.

Remove a machine you no longer use with --forget <name>.
Its transcripts are kept; only its manifest and index entries go.
--- stderr
